description: A spring-loaded plunger that sucks molten solder off a joint so you can undo a mistake.
how_to_use: Push the plunger down until it clicks, melt the joint with the iron, put the nozzle right on the molten solder and press the button — the spring snaps back and pulls the solder in.

plain.what: A spring-loaded sucker that pulls melted solder off a joint, to undo a mistake.
plain.how: Press it down until it clicks, melt the joint, hold the tip on it and press the button — whoosh.
